init.title: Grizzl-E Options
init.description: Configure the polling frequency for your charger. Cloud connections can't poll more often than every 10 seconds.

data_description.scan_interval: How often (in seconds) Home Assistant fetches data from the charger or the Grizzl-E Connect cloud.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Create a charging schedule, or update one by its ID. When updating, omitted fields keep their current values. Turn schedules on and off with their switches; the charger follows them when its charge mode is Schedule.

device_id.name: Charger
device_id.description: The Grizzl-E charger (set up through the Grizzl-E Connect cloud).

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: ID of the schedule to update (the schedule_id attribute of its switch). Leave empty to create a new schedule.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start time, in the charger's timezone.

end.name: End
end.description: End time, in the charger's timezone.

days.name: Days
days.description: Days the window applies to. Defaults to every day for a new one.

all_day.name: All day
all_day.description: Apply all day instead of between start and end.

current_limit.name: Current limit
current_limit.description: Maximum current while this schedule is active.

connector.name: Connector
connector.description: 0 for all connectors, or 1 and 2 for the cables of a Duo.

set_rate_zone.description: Create a time-of-use electricity rate zone, or update one by its ID. When updating, omitted fields keep their current values.

device_id.description: The Grizzl-E charger (set up through the Grizzl-E Connect cloud).

zone_id.name: Rate zone ID
zone_id.description: ID of the rate zone to update (the schedule_id attribute of its switch). Leave empty to create a new rate zone.

price.name: Price
